title.narrative: KE - CB to Support Gender-Responsive Implementation of the Expanded Legal Sector Reform Program

description.narrative: The IDF Grant fund proposal builds on the robust policy framework provided by the E-LSRP. [activity (e)]; and by .improving access to justice for women. [strategic intervention (g)]; and of strategic objective n.7comma by .Strengthening the overall sector institutional framework.comma as it pertains to the following activity: .strengthening the understanding of traditional justice linkages with formal justice. [strategic intervention (i)]. and Taskforce Report and aims at supporting partnership between the Legal Sector Reform Secretariat [LSRS] and the Federation of Women Lawyers. of Kenya [FIDA-Kenya] in promoting delivery of legal services to the poor and socially vulnerable. To achiev e this goalcomma the IDF Grant will: 1. FIDA completed research on women.s property rights in 2002 and on this basis has prepared a draft matrimonial property bill; (g) The gender dimension of access to land; and (h) The gender and legal dimension of HIV-AIDScomma contributing to establish an enabling environment for increased access to legal services by the poor [Component A of the IDF Grant]; 2. Promote FIDA-Kenya.s professionalization and exchange of experience with Eastern and Southern African legal aid practitioners on technical and financial sustainability in the provision of legal counsellingcomma legal literacy and legal aid [Component (D) and (E) of the IDF Grant] Assist the Recipient in institutional strengthening and capacity building to contribute to a more gender-responsive implementation of the Recipient's Expanded Legal Sector Reform Program.
